info.name: AIquila
info.summary: Private AI in your Nextcloud — chat, agents and MCP tools, with the AI provider you choose
info.description:
**AIquila** brings AI into your [Nextcloud](https://nextcloud.com) — private, self-hosted, and under your control. You choose which AI provider processes your data, including models running entirely on your own hardware.
### Nextcloud App
- **Chat** — Converse with an AI assistant about your files and documents - **Projects** — Scope a conversation to selected folders, so the assistant only sees what you choose - **Coworkers** — Save repeatable AI jobs and run them on demand or on a schedule - **Summarise & rewrite** — Condense, draft, rephrase and proofread text - **Model picker** — Switch provider and model per conversation - **Usage metrics** — Token and conversation counters exported via OpenMetrics
### Choose your AI provider
Admins enable the providers they want, and can restrict them per user or group:
- **Claude (Anthropic)** — The default, and the most deeply integrated: vision, thinking budgets, native MCP connector, and PDF handling with citations. - **Hetzner Inference** — OpenAI-compatible API from the German provider Hetzner. Currently an experimental service, free while experimental; Hetzner states it does not store request and response content. - **Mistral** — French provider, also supporting the native MCP connector. EU-only processing is available through Mistral's regional inference endpoints. - **Local model** — Ollama, LM Studio or llama.cpp on your own hardware. Nothing leaves your infrastructure. - **DeepSeek** — OpenAI-compatible API.
API keys are stored encrypted, and base URLs are admin-only settings. Provider choice applies to chat and to the Nextcloud Assistant integrations alike. Assistant actions that send images need a vision-capable provider.
### MCP Server
AIquila includes a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server with 316 tools that gives any MCP client — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Claude.ai and the Claude mobile app, Cursor, VS Code and others — direct access to your Nextcloud:
- **Files & sharing** — Browse, read, write, search, share, tag, and restore from trash or older versions - **Calendar, Tasks & Contacts** — Events, to-dos and address books over CalDAV and CardDAV, plus Deck boards and Projects - **Talk, Mail & Notifications** — Conversations, polls and reactions, mail accounts and messages, notification triage - **Photos & Maps** — Albums and metadata, GPS tracks and devices, favourites, and photo geotagging - **Notes, News, Recipes & Bookmarks** — Markdown notes, RSS feeds, recipes, and bookmark folders and tags - **Coworkers & administration** — Run saved AI jobs, manage users, groups and apps, run `occ`, and check integrity
### Resources
- [Documentation](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila/blob/main/docs/README.md) - [Source Code](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila) - [Report Issues](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila/issues) - [Discussions](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila/discussions)
---
Built on the [Nextcloud](https://nextcloud.com) open-source community, the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io), and the open and commercial AI providers listed above.
